questions: Were you fully conscious and able to understand what was happening during the episode?
Could you remember the entire episode afterward?
Were your movements under your voluntary control?
Did the episode begin suddenly?
Did you have any shaking or rhythmic jerking that you could not control?
Did the movements start in one limb or one side of your body?
Did you lose strength or become unable to move any limb?
Did you develop numbness or loss of sensation?
Did you have new neck or back pain?
Did you have loss of bladder or bowel control?
Did you bite your tongue?
Did you become confused, unusually sleepy, or difficult to awaken afterward?
Did anyone observe you becoming unresponsive?
Have you ever had a seizure or a similar episode before?
Did you recently have a head, neck, or back injury?
Did you recently have a fever or an infection?
Have you recently started, stopped, or changed any medication?
Have you used alcohol or recreational drugs recently?
Have you previously been diagnosed with a neurologic or spinal-cord disorder?
Are you currently experiencing worsening weakness, numbness, severe pain, or difficulty breathing?
